records.label: Admin List Filter By Related Item
records.description: Expose a relation-aware admin list filter that narrows source objects by a selected related item without moving filter semantics into Admin Columns.

records.label: REST Relation Read / Public Access Policy
records.description: Configure relation-level REST read authorization/public exposure separately from mutation permission so public reads and protected writes cannot be conflated.

coverage.notes: Market-audit gaps confirmed independently by JetEngine and Meta Box: relation-specific admin filtering and explicit REST read/public-access policy.
